# Clara OS Copilot Instructions

You are contributing to Clara OS.

## General rules

- Generate production-ready TypeScript.
- Follow SOLID principles.
- Follow Clean Architecture.
- One responsibility per class.
- No TODO.
- No placeholder code.
- No commented-out code.

## Project conventions

- Every connector exposes an index.ts.
- Every connector contains a module.ts.
- Public APIs must remain stable.
- Reuse existing modules whenever possible.

## Documentation

- Use English comments.
- Add JSDoc to public classes and methods.

## Validation

- Generated code must compile.
- Never leave files empty.
